known_issues.summary: The first conformance acceptance run (run-0b3447c0f2a7e8220eed42e3) was executed by a stale pre-candidate worker (factory 0.7.3) still polling the shared default Temporal task queue 'factory'; the run succeeded but its durable manifest factory_version is 0.7.3, so it did not validate the 1.0.0 candidate. Stale workers (systemd user unit esf-worker.service from 0.7.2, plus local workers) were deliberately left running. Fixed by re-running the acceptance gate on a unique queue esf-beta1-validation-20261105 using a build from HEAD 8f692108 (identical Go source); the valid run run-8426d021f427ff4240804201 records factory_version 1.0.0. Invalid artifacts are retained under superseded/ and are not cited as evidence.
